17                Would you please recognize Senator 

18   Sanders, who has an announcement.

19                ACTING PRESIDENT AKSHAR:   Senator 

20   Sanders.

21                SENATOR SANDERS:   Thank you, sir.

22                The essence of democracy of course 

23   is citizen participation.  Indeed, the safeguard 

24   of our democracy is citizen participation.  

25                I just want to draw your attention 


                                                                1894

 1   to one of the youngest people to participate in 

 2   that movement, a person who wrote a bill to me 

 3   and said that this is what we should do.

 4                Nicholas, would you mind just 

 5   standing for a moment?  Ah, there you are.  I've 

 6   got to take off my reading glasses.

 7                This young man wrote my office and 

 8   said that he wanted something good done, and I 

 9   believed in it, and we are trying to do this.  So 

10   I wanted to draw attention to him.  And he 

11   brought his whole family on this snowy day.  

12                Having said that, I'll allow you to 

13   sit down, Nicholas, and thank you very much for 

14   allowing me to speak in favor of Nicholas and 

15   indeed in favor of democracy.  

16                Thank you.

17                ACTING PRESIDENT AKSHAR:   Thank 

18   you, Senator Sanders.

19                Nicholas, we welcome you and your 

20   family to this great house.  Thank you.
